create.name: Ekta Bathija
create.bio:
Ekta Bathija is a teacher of self-inquiry who has guided students since 1998 and now leads Gnyana Sangha from St. George, Utah. Rather than holding to one tradition, she teaches across several: Advaita Vedanta and the Upanishads, the Buddha's discourses and Zen parables, Ramana Maharshi's question 'Who am I?', and the songs of Saint Kabir, alongside the teachings of Nisargadatta Maharaj and Atmananda Krishna Menon. Her view is that every real path points to the same recognition, so students may follow whichever one draws them.

Her teaching is structured and demanding. Students watch recorded sessions, do written homework and quizzes, keep a daily spiritual journal and sit for exams, and those who complete the groundwork may join her Gurukul and ask for one-to-one mentoring. She gives particular weight to what dreams and deep sleep reveal about the self, a practice she calls Swapna Nidra Gnyana. Sessions run online and in person, from weekend gatherings to silent retreats of up to twenty-four days, and she charges no fees for any of them. She has written a series of books she calls Drishti, or direct seeing, on texts such as Ramana's Nan Yar and the Rama Gita, and she publishes talks on a group of YouTube channels and a podcast, I AM THAT.

books.title: I: Ko'Ham Drishti: Direct Seeing of Ramana Maharshi's Who Am I [Nan Yar]: Not a Translation, Not a Commentary
books.author: Ekta Bathija
books.description: Ekta works through the twenty-eight questions and answers of Ramana Maharshi's short text Nan Yar, reading each one as an invitation to look for yourself rather than as doctrine. It is meant to be read slowly, alongside self-inquiry.

books.title: 365 Insights That Liberate: Advaita Drishti: Volume 1: Direct Seeing of Non-Duality
books.author: Ekta Bathija
books.description: A year of short daily pointers from Advaita Vedanta, one for each day. Each is a brief statement to test against your own experience, building towards seeing through the sense of a separate self.

books.title: Black Hole of Equanimity: Rama Drishti: Direct Seeing of Rama Gita
books.author: Ekta Bathija
books.description: A verse-by-verse reading of the Rama Gita, the Vedantic teaching Rama gives to his brother Lakshmana. Ekta offers her own seeing of each verse rather than a scholarly translation.

books.title: Beyond the Veil of Sleep and Dream: Swapna Nidra Gnyana Sadhana - An Advaita Exploration of Dream and Sleep Wisdom
books.author: Ekta Bathija
books.description: Her guide to Swapna Nidra Gnyana, the practice at the centre of her teaching, which uses the dream and deep-sleep states to question what we take to be real in waking life.

free_resources.title: Ekta Bathija on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Talks and guided self-inquiry sessions drawn from Advaita, the Buddha's teaching and Zen stories, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Advaita Basics - Semester I
free_resources.description: A free online course and the usual starting point with Gnyana Sangha. Recorded explanation sessions on the basics of Advaita come with homework sheets, short quizzes and a weekly sitting practice.

free_resources.title: Drg Drishya Viveka - Semester I & II
free_resources.description: A free recorded course on the classic Vedanta text about telling the seer apart from what is seen, taught session by session with exercises in self-inquiry.

free_resources.title: I AM THAT by Ekta Bathija (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of talks on non-duality and the inner path, also available on Apple Podcasts, iHeart and Amazon Music.

free_resources.title: Ancient Wisdom Pearls blog
free_resources.description: A large archive of short written answers to seekers' questions, sorted by theme from karma and relationships to meditation and the masters, in English and Hindi.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 2.5k (profile via WebFetch, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube main channel @GnyanaSanghawithEktaBathija 398 (header row, 1 Nov 2026) plus her eleven linked teaching channels as listed on its Channels tab (Vedic Scriptures 4.9k, Advaita 2.53k, Ramana Maharshi 1.74k, Nisargadatta 1.35k, Bodhic suttas 1k, Atmananda 918, Saint Kabir 615, Meditations 485, Zen Parables 440, Rama Drishti 140, Ashtavakra 48; ~14.2k); Instagram 1,353 (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook and X not readable without login → ~18.4k total → local_hero
flags: Email is the general Gnyana Sangha inbox (ekta.gnyanasangha@gmail.com, the Contact link on gnyanasangha.com), not a personal address.

Base taken from her Insight Timer profile (St. George, USA); her sites describe in-person sessions and silent retreats but give no address or current dates, and the store shows prices in rupees, so she may also teach in India.
No paid offerings: all sessions, retreats, the Gurukul and one-to-one mentoring are stated as free of charge, so the courses list is empty and her free courses are listed as free resources.
Sub-channel subscriber counts come from the main channel's Channels tab, not each channel's own header row.
Her own site says the Gnyana Sangha site and blog 'are not mine' (created by students); she is clearly the teacher on both, so they are used as her website.
Dev dry run: a book with the same title as 'I: Ko'Ham Drishti' is already on dev under justin-perry (id 40); likely a mis-attached record there, worth checking before insert.
left_out: It's a Rope, Not a Snake (B0D8ZBRWWK) and Insight of Dispassion (B0CRPQT2V4): amazon.com /dp/ pages returned 500.
Viveka Journal and Buddha Journal workbooks: blank journals rather than books of teaching.
About fifteen further ISBNs linked from gnyanasangha.com: amazon.com pages did not load a title, not verified.
Individual mentorship and Gurukul: free and gated by prerequisites, with no page of their own that loads (mentorship link 404s).
Shorter numbered clips under 3 minutes on the Vedic Scriptures channel: kept only the one most-viewed.
